en: {player}! Have you heard the old story? This sundial's stone fell from the sky long ago, the night Kalos first saw a Mega Evolution.
Its light still reaches every Key Stone and Mega Stone in the region. Hold your Key Stone up to it, would you?
The sundial's stone gave off a soft light, and the Key Stone {player} carried shone back at it.
Magnifique! Now your Key Stone will feel the Mega Stones hidden all over Kalos. Trainers of old left them everywhere.
In caves and forests, in a Gym and a castle, by the sea and in the snow. Go and find them all!
Oh, and before I forget. Someone left a note for you at my laboratory. It said only: the bureau south of Rouge Plaza. L.
